'''M4-1S''' was a [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The M4-1S Astromech Droid was a gift given to all players through their mailbox in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a gift for [[May 4|Star Wars Day]] starting on [[May 4]], [[2015]]. It was first announced in a livestream centered on Game Update 3.2.
